list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Add player login event handling and improve mob spawn logic
- Introduced `onPlayerLogin` to manage HUD and timer state on player login. - Enhanced mob spawning logic with proper initialization, e.g., ensuring equipment like Crossbows for Pillagers. - Reset `elapsedTicks` on state transitions in `RandomizerManager`. - Expanded mob blacklist configuration. - Added helper methods for sending HUD actions and timers to specific players.

task.summary:
Add initial implementation of Randomizer mod
Includes: - Core mod setup with `@Mod` annotation. - Event handling and initialization via `Randomizer` and `RandomizerManager`. - Definitions of data structures (EffectEntry, ItemEntry, MobEntry). - Random selection and application logic inside `RandomPools`. - Configuration handling in `RandomizerConfig`. - Simple HUD display with `RandomizerHud`. - Command registration for managing Randomizer states.

Add initial implementation of Randomizer mod
Includes: - Core mod setup with `@Mod` annotation. - Event handling and initialization via `Randomizer` and `RandomizerManager`. - Definitions of data structures (EffectEntry, ItemEntry, MobEntry). - Random selection and application logic inside `RandomPools`. - Configuration handling in `RandomizerConfig`. - Simple HUD display with `RandomizerHud`. - Command registration for managing Randomizer states.

Add timer synchronization and HUD control networking
Includes: - `RandomizerTimerPayload` for syncing elapsed timer ticks and running state between server and clients. - `RandomizerHudPayload` for syncing HUD actions (START, PAUSE, STOP) to clients. - Integration of timers and HUD updates in `RandomizerManager` and `Randomizer`. - `RandomizerClientPayloadHandler` to handle client-side HUD and timer updates. - New `RandomizerNetwork` utility for registering and sending networking payloads.

v0.1.1 – HUD Reset Fixes & Timer Improvements
🐛 Fix - Fixed HUD not resetting when disconnecting from a server (Logout → Menu → Singleplayer). - Fixed timer continuing visually after leaving a world. - Prevented HUD from remaining visible when no world or player is loaded.
🔧 Improvement - Added additional HUD safety reset in renderer to catch cases where logout events are not fired. - Improved `/randomizer status` output to display time as mm:ss instead of raw ticks.

# Randomizer v0.2.0 – HUD Customization & Configuration Overhaul
This release delivers a major quality-of-life improvement by separating gameplay configuration (COMMON) from UI configuration (CLIENT), introducing a fully customizable HUD, and enhancing the overall configuration experience.
---
## ✨ Features * Added `disableHud`: Allows hiding the timer entirely * Added `hudX` + `hudY` for adjustable HUD placement * HUD settings now fully configurable in-game via NeoForge's configuration menu * Added dedicated client-only configuration file (`config/randomizer-client.toml`)
---
## 🔧 Improvements * Implemented safe-area rendering (prevents hotbar overlap) * Reduced HUD jittering across different GUI scales * Added translation keys for all config categories and entries * Added descriptive tooltips for all HUD-related settings
---
## 🐛 Fixes * Fixed HUD remaining visible after server disconnect or world changes * Fixed timer preserved incorrectly when switching between SP and MP * Added world/player null-safety checks to prevent stale HUD rendering * Fixed minor rendering inconsistencies across resolutions
---
## 📦 Modpack / Config * COMMON config now strictly server-authoritative (gameplay logic only) * CLIENT config now handles UI/HUD settings exclusively * Cleaner generated TOML files with readable structure and categories
---
## 🧩 Refactor * Moved all HUD-related definitions to the new Client config class * Simplified HUD render logic, state reset, and safe-area calculations * Separated categories in the configuration system (General, Content, Effects, Mobs, HUD)
---
## 📁 File / Project Structure * Added dedicated Client EntryPoint (`IConfigScreenFactory`) * Improved localization structure under `assets/randomizer/lang/` * Reorganized config initialization for clarity and maintainability
---
## ❤️ Special Thanks Thanks to everyone who tested the pre-release build and helped shape the new HUD customization system!

# Randomizer v0.3.0 – Display Overhaul & Experimental Bossbar Mode
This release significantly improves how events are displayed to the player and introduces an early experimental version of the Bossbar progress indicator.
---
## ✨ Features * Added **experimental Bossbar mode** (opt-in via config) - Displays progress toward the next event - Fully server-controlled - Currently not perfectly synchronized with HUD time → experimental label * Improved event announcement formatting using readable tags: - `[Item]`, `[Effect]`, `[Mob]`
---
## 🔧 Improvements * Reworked event-timing pipeline for improved consistency * More robust handling of pause/resume cycles * HUD display logic refined * Better clarity in all in-game system messages
---
## 🐛 Fixes * Fixed silent event failures in certain edge cases * Fixed HUD state getting stuck after reconnect * Fixed multiple small sync issues between timer states
---
## 📦 Modpack / Config * Added new **Display** config category * Added `enableBossbar` (default: false) * Added `showHudWithBossbar` (currently reserved for future behavior) * Updated translation keys and tooltips for all display options
---
## 📁 File / Project Structure * Improved separation between display logic, HUD logic, and event execution * Added new translation entries under `assets/randomizer/lang/` * General internal cleanup to prepare for 1.0.0
---
## ⚠️ Experimental Notice Bossbar mode is functional but not final. It is included for testing and user feedback before the 1.0.0 milestone.

Includes: - New `/randomizer manual` command for triggering random events for specific players. - `triggerManualEventForPlayer` method in `RandomizerManager`. - Added `allowManualWhenStopped` config option under a new "Admin" category. - Improved logging and error handling for manual events. - Code cleanup for event types and command structure.

Initialize development environment and logging configuration
Includes: - Gradle 8.8 setup with additional project properties. - IntelliJ IDEA configuration files (`.idea`, Gradle settings). - Log4j2 XML configurations for client, data, and game test server environments. - Run configurations and JVM arguments for mod development and testing. - Added license file and project metadata.

Update IntelliJ IDEA project configuration
Includes: - Added `.iml` module files and updated `modules.xml`. - Adjusted Gradle cache references and project paths. - Updated workspace.xml with new task and change tracking details.
Add `.gitignore` to exclude build and IDE files
